name: Holo UI Vault — Agent Router v2
context_guards: DO NOT read beautifului-components/index.html (32KB preview, wastes tokens).
DO NOT scan directories. Use paths from this file or manifests.
Budget: max 1 snippet + 1 shared CSS per task.
For ambiguous requests, filter by feature tokens in INDEX.json (spec in FEATURE_TOKENS.md).
Review STYLE_AND_SELECTION_GUIDE.md only when mixing multiple styles.

ai_native_productivity.desc: Cold neutral, dark-first, high information density, 0.5px hairlines, tabular figures, subtle shimmer transitions.

apple_human_interface.desc: Humanist, tactile spatial depth, continuous squircle curvature, liquid glass blur, spring physics, 44pt touch friendliness.

kinetic_motion_tactile.desc: Physical spring damping, continuous fluid morphing, 3D orbital rotations, kinetic typography, Lilac & Orange accent palette.

micro_motion_indicators.desc: Minimalist, zero-runtime, pure CSS/SVG, hairline single strokes, 3x3 pixel matrices, and 3D quantum wireframes.

minimal_theme_toggles.desc: Pure CSS/SVG, 1em vector morphing, zero-runtime, accessible, clip-path and path transitions, reduced-motion guards.

obsidian_tactile_showcase.desc: Apple-style spring physics, expanding rounded corners, outward shift on hover, partner split cards, and dotted divider.

arc_motion_primitives.desc: OKLCH color system, motion/react physics-based spring curves, useMorphWidth dynamic resize, and zero layout shift micro-interactions.

localmode_edge_ai.desc: shadcn/Tailwind CSS v4 tokens, local-first browser AI surfaces, WebGPU/WASM hardware awareness, token budget meters, and on-device multi-modal UI.
